proposal_name: Corporate Group Term Life & Employee Pension Plan RFP
extracted_text:
CORPORATE GROUP TERM LIFE & RETIREMENT BENEFIT RFP
RFP Reference No: RFP-CORP-GTL-2026-901
Issuing Authority: Global Apex Conglomerate Enterprise
Target Insurance Archetype: Group Life & Employee Benefits
Policy Effective Date: November 1, 2026 – October 31, 2027

1. COVERAGE SCOPE & LIMITS:
- Line of Business: Group Term Life Insurance (GTL) and Group Personal Accident (GPA)
- Total Covered Lives: 10,000 Full-time permanent employees
- Sum Insured Limit: INR 500 Crore (Flat ₹50 Lakh per employee across management & staff)
- Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Rider: 200% of base sum insured
- Terminal Illness Acceleration: 50% prepayment upon diagnosis of terminal illness
- Critical Illness Sub-limit: INR 100 Crore aggregate pool
- Deductibles: Nil deductible on life claims; INR 25,000 on disability medical rider
- Key Exclusions: Active participation in war or civil commotion; suicide within first 12 months of coverage

2. PRICING & PAYMENT TERMS:
- Estimated Annual Gross Premium Budget: INR 12.50 Crore
- Payment Terms: Quarterly installment schedule (INR 3.125 Crore per quarter) with 30-day grace period
- Rate Guarantee: Flat rate per mille guarantee for 24 months

3. UNDERWRITING & RISK REQUIREMENTS:
- Free Cover Limit (FCL): Up to INR 1.50 Crore per employee without medical underwriting
- Tele-medical examination required only for coverage exceeding INR 1.50 Crore
- Solvency Requirement: Insurer must maintain a statutory solvency margin ratio strictly above 1.75x
- Loss Ratio Tolerance: Combined burning cost underwritten at 85% benchmark

4. CLAIMS & SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENTS (SLA):
- Claim Intimation SLA: Online intimation within 90 days of insured event
- Death Claim Settlement Turnaround: Mandatory payout within 7 business days of document receipt
- Penalties: 1% monthly interest penalty on claims delayed beyond 14 business days
- Dedicated Claims Desk: Dedicated on-site or virtual enterprise account manager

5. TECHNOLOGY & INTEGRATION REQUIREMENTS:
- Digital Enrollment: Self-service employee web & mobile portal for nominee updates and e-cards
- System Integration: REST API integration with enterprise HRMS (Workday and Darwinbox)
- Cybersecurity & Privacy: Insurer must possess ISO 27001 certification and DPDP Act compliance

6. DYNAMIC & PROPOSAL-SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS:
- Multilingual Member Support: 24x7 member helpline supporting English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Marathi
- Automated Payroll Census Reconciliation: Monthly automated SFTP census batch ingestion
